brand_concept: Open Verdicts reads as a somber forensic archive — an evidence room from a century that never gave back its answers. The visual identity leans into implied absence and unfinished business: a single object, lit like a still life, that carries the weight of a case the record never closed.
color_palette: aged parchment, oxblood ink, gaslight amber, cold slate
